description.zh: 距离一个日期还有几天几时几分：按指定时区的墙上时间算，到点之后改成已经过去的说法。
description.en: Days, hours and minutes to a date in the wall time of a chosen time zone; after the moment passes it says how long ago it was.

props.time.hint.zh: 目标时刻，写成 HH:mm；全天时不看这一项
props.time.hint.en: The target time, written HH:mm; ignored when all day

props.allDay.hint.zh: 按目标时区当天的 00:00 算
props.allDay.hint.en: Counts from 00:00 of that day in the target time zone

props.zone.hint.zh: IANA 名字，省略时按 Asia/Shanghai
props.zone.hint.en: An IANA name; Asia/Shanghai when omitted

props.offsetMinutes.hint.zh: 仅重复时刻必须填，例如纽约夏令时 -240、标准时 -300；其它时间可留空
props.offsetMinutes.hint.en: Required for ambiguous times, e.g. -240 or -300 in New York; otherwise optional

props.note.hint.zh: 一行说明，矮盒子里收起
props.note.hint.en: One line of context; hidden in short boxes

empty.zh: 还没设日期，在设置里填一个
empty.en: No date yet — set one in the card settings

badTime.zh: 时刻读不出来，写成 HH:mm；全天项目不看这一项
badTime.en: The time could not be read; write it as HH:mm

invalidZone.zh: 时区无效，请填写 IANA 时区名

zoneHint.zh: 按 {zone} 的墙上时间计算
